text: Every planning lesson pointed here -- Theo opens Oracle Fusion Setup and builds the real five-segment chart of accounts: Company, Cost Center, Account, Intercompany, and Future.
Company 01 is Stonefield Distribution Inc. Cost Centers 100, 210, 220, and 230 cover Corporate and the three warehouses. Account values like 2100 and 6400 start the natural account list.
Company is flagged as the balancing segment, Account as the natural account segment -- the two flags that let Oracle validate every journal line from here forward.
The legal entity, Stonefield Distribution Inc., and the ledger, Stonefield Primary Ledger, get built last, tying the chart of accounts, calendar, and currency together.
Next: building Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable for real, on top of this exact structure.
